reason: User replaced average-threshold ranking with one best experiment prioritizing strong precipitation. Earlier 14 results already known; this is prospective only for eight extension runs, not independent validation.

experiment.intervention: Only native initial QSNOW, float64(source)*float64(alpha), cast to native float32; all other fields and metadata unchanged from family baseline.

evaluation.strong_precipitation_definition: Study threshold of hourly precipitation >=10 mm, not an official warning classification.

selection.eligible_cases: 14 completed previous family cases plus 8 extension cases; CURRENT_HYDRO contextual only
selection.undefined_scores: Undefined CSI ranked below defined CSI; undefined FAR after defined FAR. Never convert undefined metric to zero.
outputs: all cases by every lead and threshold with contingency counts and continuous errors
selection.previous_error_guard: Previous B1 RMSE and pooled-error vetoes do not govern this user-requested strong-precipitation ranking. Report all degradations explicitly.
selection.incomplete_or_failed_cases: Exclude from completed six-hour ranking; preserve failure evidence.

limitations: Same-event parameter selection, no independent skill claim.
QSNOW-only perturbation deliberately changes initial water without vapor/temperature/auxiliary compensation; diagnostic sensitivity, not conservative or operational initialization.
Verify total surface precipitation, not surface snowfall alone.
No averaging across thresholds, leads, or experiments for ranking.
More severe untested thresholds do not silently replace the primary endpoint.
Family comparisons include both initialization and executable changes.
